name: floci-control-plane
description: Turns a founder's plain-language product request into a verified, running local infra environment on Floci.
long_description: The Floci control-plane harness, exposed as an MCP server. Give it a plain-language request ("users should be able to upload a photo") and it matches it against a capability catalog, runs the provisioning recipe, and independently re-verifies the result before ever reporting it as done -- the calling agent's own claim of success is never trusted. Requires Floci (https://floci.io/) running locally via Docker -- see the project README for the one-time ./setup.sh step that installs it. This bundle only wires the MCP server itself into Claude Desktop; it does not install Docker or Floci.
